flashcard_questions.q: The total distance a vehicle travels from the moment a hazard is seen to the moment the vehicle comes to a complete stop.
The distance a vehicle travels during the driver’s reaction time, before the brakes are applied.
The time between a stimulus being detected and a response being made.

flashcard_questions.a: The distance a vehicle travels from the moment the brakes are applied to the moment it comes to a complete stop.
The force applied by the braking system to slow a vehicle down, which causes work to be done against kinetic energy.
